remove.description:
If false, then the App.NodePool.AutoScaleStrategy is added, if absent
If true, then the App.NodePool.AutoScaleStrategy is removed, if present

deactivate.description:
If false, then the App.NodePool.AutoScaleStrategy is activated, if present
If true, then the App.NodePool.AutoScaleStrategy is deactivated, if present

title: Specification for configuring various {@link App.NodePool.AutoScaleStrategy} sub types
